## Criteria

<!-- rubric:begin -->
1. [shared] When editing the body text, distinguish between URLs explicitly named in the source transcript and those inferred from the speaker's affiliation or project name.
   - cites: bad-001, bad-003, bad-005, bad-007, bad-009, bad-011, bad-017, bad-019
   - maps_to: invented_url
2. [shared] When editing front matter, distinguish between the source identifier present in the raw metadata and the identifier reconstructed from the video title or context.
   - cites: bad-005, bad-013
   - maps_to: wrong_metadata
3. [surface:digest_note] When editing the summary, distinguish between a complete narrative digest and a raw transcript dump or a placeholder indicating processing failure.
   - cites: bad-015
   - maps_to: missing_section
4. [shared] When editing the summary, distinguish between a truncated source recording and a complete source recording that simply ends abruptly.
   - cites: bad-019
   - maps_to: false_cutoff_claim
5. [shared] When editing the summary, distinguish between qualitative descriptions of performance and the specific quantitative metrics provided by the speaker.
   - cites: bad-009, bad-011
   - maps_to: omitted_numerical_data
6. [shared] When editing the summary, distinguish between the speaker's explicit caveats regarding scope or duration and a generalized statement of capability.
   - cites: bad-001, bad-003, bad-005, bad-007, bad-009, bad-011, bad-013, bad-015, bad-017, bad-019
   - maps_to: none
<!-- rubric:end -->
